name: Ghetto Justice
description: Ghetto Justice is a German punk and hardcore outfit known for fusing crust-influenced metal riffing with raw, socially charged hardcore punk energy. Blending aggression with a DIY ethic, the band delivers fast, uncompromising songs rooted in the German underground punk and metal scene.

name: Die Habenichtse
description: Die Habenichtse are a German folk-rock band from Hannover, formed in 2011 by musicians with roots in the LARP and medieval-music scene as well as hardcore and punk. Known for acoustic, party-driven "vagabond folk" with German lyrics, they mix boisterous celebration with melancholic depth, as heard on albums like Schmierentheater.

name: Motorjesus
description: Motorjesus is a German hard rock and heavy metal band known for its raw, riff-driven sound steeped in stoner and desert-rock grit. Formed in the early 2000s, the group built a reputation through relentless touring and a gritty, whiskey-soaked style drawing comparisons to Motörhead and classic stoner rock.

name: Hackneyed
description: Hackneyed is a German death metal band formed in Ludwigsburg in 2004, known for brutal, technically sharp riffing paired with guttural vocals. The group has released several full-length albums showcasing a modern, aggressive take on old-school death metal, earning a solid reputation on the European underground circuit.

name: Excrementory Grindfuckers
description: Excrementory Grindfuckers are a German grindcore band formed in 1999, celebrated for pairing blistering, chaotic blast-beat grindcore with a heavy dose of parody and dark humor. Known for absurdist lyrics and irreverent stage antics, they have become a cult favorite within the extreme metal underground.

name: Betontod
description: Betontod is a German punk rock band formed in Krefeld in 2001, known for melodic, anthemic punk rock sung in German with socially and politically engaged lyrics. Over multiple studio albums, the band has built a dedicated following in the German punk scene for its energetic, singalong sound.

name: Airbourne
description: Airbourne is an Australian hard rock band formed in Warrnambool in 2003, celebrated for its high-octane, AC/DC-inspired sound built on raw riffs, gritty vocals and relentless live energy. Albums like Runnin' Wild and No Guts. No Glory. cemented their reputation as one of modern rock's most electrifying live acts.

name: In Flames
description: In Flames is a Swedish band formed in Gothenburg in 1990, widely regarded as pioneers of the melodic death metal sound alongside fellow Gothenburg acts. Known for albums such as The Jester Race and Clayman, the band has evolved over three decades into a genre-blending force within modern metal.

name: Hatebreed
description: Hatebreed is an American hardcore and metalcore band formed in Connecticut in 1994, renowned for its crushing, beatdown-driven sound and aggressive breakdowns. Fronted by Jamey Jasta, the band's albums, including Perseverance and The Rise of Brutality, have made them a cornerstone of modern hardcore.

name: Alcest
description: Alcest is a French band formed in 1999 by Neige, widely credited with pioneering the blackgaze genre by blending atmospheric black metal with shoegaze and post-metal textures. Albums such as Souvenirs d'un autre monde and Écailles de lune established their ethereal, dreamlike sound within the metal landscape.

name: Blasmusik Illenschwang
description: Blasmusik Illenschwang is a traditional Bavarian brass band from Wittelshofen known for an unexpected twist: performing heavy metal and rock anthems in classic oompah brass-band arrangements. The novelty act has won over metal audiences with its tongue-in-cheek reinterpretations of genre staples on tuba, trumpet and clarinet.

name: Neckbreakker
description: Neckbreakker is a Danish death metal band formed in Silkeborg in 2020, quickly rising to prominence with a modern take on classic Scandinavian death metal fused with hardcore-influenced grooves. Signed to Nuclear Blast, their debut album Within the Viscera showcases their blistering, crushing sound.

name: The Narrator
description: The Narrator is an American indie rock band known for angular, literate songwriting and a raw, energetic live sound rooted in the mid-2000s Chicago underground rock scene. Their music combines sharp guitar interplay with sardonic, wordy lyricism characteristic of the era's post-punk-inflected indie rock.

name: Green Lung
description: Green Lung is a British doom metal band formed in London in 2016, known for blending heavy, riff-laden doom with psychedelic and occult rock atmospherics. Albums like Woodland Rites and Black Harvest have established them as leading figures in the modern occult-rock revival.

name: Paradise Lost
description: Paradise Lost is a British band formed in Halifax in 1988, widely regarded as pioneers of gothic and doom metal. Alongside albums like Gothic and Icon, the band helped shape an entire genre and has continued evolving across a career spanning more than three decades of dark, atmospheric metal.

name: Eivør
description: Eivør is a singer-songwriter from the Faroe Islands known for a richly expressive voice spanning jazz, folk and atmospheric pop influences. Since her solo debut in 2000, she has built an acclaimed international career blending Nordic folk roots with cinematic, genre-crossing songwriting.

name: Miracle Of Sound
description: Miracle of Sound is a project led by Irish musician Gavin Dunne, known for atmospheric, melodic rock and folk-tinged songs inspired by video games, films and pop culture. Since the early 2010s, the solo artist has built a large online following through richly produced, narrative-driven original compositions.

name: Persecutor
description: Persecutor is a Danish thrash metal band formed in 2018, known for fast, aggressive riffing paired with melodic hooks that define the modern neo-thrash sound. Albums including Rebirth, Vendetta and Casualties of Violence have established the band among Denmark's leading contemporary thrash acts.

name: King Nugget Gang
description: King Nugget Gang is a German band from Gönnheim, active since 2016, known for an irreverent crossover style blending trap-influenced beats, heavy riffs and playful, food-obsessed lyrical themes. The group has built a devoted following through high-energy live shows and a distinctly offbeat identity.

name: Inhuman Nature
description: Inhuman Nature is a British thrash metal band known for a fierce, crossover-thrash sound that combines old-school thrash aggression with hardcore punk energy. Rooted in the UK underground metal scene, the band delivers fast, riff-heavy songs built around relentless tempos and gritty vocals.

name: Urne
description: Urne is a British band from London known for a heavy, genre-crossing sound that weaves together progressive metal, metalcore and sludge influences. Their music combines intricate, technical songwriting with crushing weight, marking them as one of the UK underground's more ambitious modern acts.

name: Castle Rat
description: Castle Rat is an American doom metal band from New York, known for fusing classic heavy metal riffs with dark fantasy imagery and theatrical presentation. Fronted by vocalist Riley Pinkerton, the group draws on 1970s doom and occult rock traditions to craft an evocative, story-driven sound.

name: Cân Bardd
description: Cân Bardd is a Swiss atmospheric black metal project blending raw black metal aggression with folk melodies and atmospheric textures. Drawing on Welsh-inspired naming and imagery, the one-person act crafts emotive, nature-themed compositions that bridge black metal's intensity with folk metal's melodic sensibility.

802 is a Danish outfit blending heavy metal aesthetics with synthpop hooks, formed when producer Andreas Asingh joined forces with musicians from the Djursland metal underground. Since their 2023 debut single, the band has drawn attention for their genre-crossing mix of distortion, melody and electronic production.

name: Born Hanged
description: Born Hanged is a German band from Karlsruhe formed in 2018, blending death metal brutality with hardcore punk aggression into a mosh-ready, riff-heavy sound. Signed to Death Farm Records, the band explores dark themes of nihilism and violence across releases including the album Left to Rot.

name: Dethroned
description: Dethroned is a German death metal band known for combining melodic death metal songwriting with crushing, technically driven riffing. Rooted in the German extreme metal underground, the group delivers a modern, aggressive sound that balances brutality with melodic hooks.

name: Backstabbed
description: Backstabbed is a German hardcore punk band from Offenburg, active since 2018, known for blending hardcore, rap and funky grooves with metal riffs. Nicknamed "Germany's Heaviest Boygroup," the band pairs high-energy crossover hardcore with lyrics promoting diversity and mental health awareness.

name: Ochmoneks
description: Ochmoneks is a German punk rock band from Düsseldorf, formed in 2015, known for energetic, German-language punk and rock anthems dealing with friendship, love and everyday life. The band has released multiple studio albums and earned recognition at the German Rock & Pop Prize for its melodic, stadium-ready sound.

name: Waves Like Walls
description: Waves Like Walls is a five-piece hardcore and metal band formed in 2012 in Ingolstadt, Germany, known for raw, aggressive songwriting built on fast riffs and crushing breakdowns. The group blends confrontational hardcore punk intensity with melodic hooks, delivering an emotionally charged, high-energy sound.

name: Thormesis
description: Thormesis is a German black metal band known for combining raw black metal aggression with rock-oriented songwriting and melodic undercurrents. Formed in the German underground scene, the band has built a reputation for a distinctive, atmospheric approach that sets it apart from more orthodox black metal acts.

name: Our Promise
description: Our Promise is a German metalcore sextet formed in Stuttgart in late 2020, known for a blistering twin-vocalist assault that fuses metalcore, hardcore and pop-punk melodies. Since their 2021 EP Unbreakable, the band has built a rapidly growing fanbase through anthemic, high-energy songwriting.

name: From Fall To Spring
description: From Fall to Spring is a German band blending post-hardcore, metalcore and nu-metal influences into an emotionally driven, riff-heavy sound. Rooted in the German alternative metal scene, the group combines melodic vocal hooks with heavy breakdowns and modern, groove-laden songwriting.

name: Alien Ant Farm
description: Alien Ant Farm is an American alternative rock and nu-metal band formed in Riverside, California, in 1996, best known for their 2001 album ANThology and its hit single, a cover of Michael Jackson's "Smooth Criminal." The band blends funky grooves, heavy riffs and melodic hooks in its signature sound.

name: Northlane
description: Northlane are an Australian metalcore band formed in Sydney in 2009, known for blending djent-style riffing with electronic and industrial textures. Across albums like Node, Alien, and Obsidian, they have pushed the genre's boundaries while cycling through several vocalists, becoming one of Australia's most influential heavy exports.

name: Kim Dracula
description: Kim Dracula is an Australian musician known for a theatrical fusion of trap metal, screamo, and industrial-tinged pop, marked by dramatic vocal shifts from melodic singing to guttural screams. Rising through online platforms, tracks like "Vampire" built a devoted following for their genre-blending, horror-infused aesthetic and visual style.

name: Imminence
description: Imminence are a Swedish metalcore band formed in Falkenberg in 2007, fronted by Eddie Berg, whose operatic clean vocals contrast with heavy breakdowns and post-hardcore intensity. Albums such as Turn the Light On and The Black established them as a leading force in Scandinavia's modern metalcore scene.

name: Saxon
description: Saxon are an English heavy metal band formed in Barnsley in 1976, among the founding pillars of the New Wave of British Heavy Metal alongside Iron Maiden and Def Leppard. Fronted by Biff Byford since inception, classics like Wheels of Steel and Denim and Leather cemented their lasting influence.

name: Eisbrecher
description: Eisbrecher are a German industrial metal band formed in 2003 by former Megaherz members, playing within the Neue Deutsche Härte tradition alongside acts like Rammstein. Known for driving guitars, electronic layers, and German-language lyrics, albums such as Sünde and Schicksalsmelodien built a strong following across Europe.

name: Amorphis
description: Amorphis are a Finnish band formed in Helsinki in 1990, evolving from early death metal roots into a distinctive blend of melodic death and progressive metal steeped in Finnish folklore, notably the Kalevala. Long fronted by Tomi Joutsen, albums like Tales from the Thousand Lakes remain genre landmarks.

name: dArtagnan
description: dArtagnan are a German folk-rock band formed in Nuremberg in 2015 by Ben Metzner, Felix Fischer, and Tim Bernard, named after the famed musketeer. Known for their self-styled "Musketeer Rock," blending folk instrumentation with anthemic rock hooks, albums like Felsenfest and Herzblut reached the German charts' top five.

name: Fulci
description: Fulci are an Italian death metal band formed in 2015, taking their name from horror director Lucio Fulci as a tribute to his gruesome films. Their brutal, riff-driven sound and splatter-movie imagery, showcased on albums like Untrue Detective, pay direct homage to classic Italian horror cinema.

name: Massive Wagons
description: Massive Wagons are an English rock band formed in Lancaster in 2009, blending hard rock energy with hooky, working-class songwriting reminiscent of the New Wave of Classic Rock. Fronted by Barry Mills, albums including Full Nelson, Triggered, and the chart-topping Earth to Grace built a devoted UK following.

name: Grand Magus
description: Grand Magus are a Swedish band formed in Stockholm in 1996, fusing traditional heavy metal with doom and stoner influences into a mighty, riff-heavy sound often inspired by Norse mythology. Fronted by JB Christoffersson, albums like Iron Will and Sword Songs earned them wide acclaim in European metal circles.

name: Deserted Fear
description: Deserted Fear are a German death metal band formed in Erfurt in 2009, known for classic, Swedish-influenced death metal riffing delivered with modern intensity and a relentless touring schedule. Albums such as Kingdom of the Forsaken and Doomsday established them as a rising name in European death metal.

name: Trollfest
description: TrollfesT are a Norwegian folk metal band formed in Oslo in 2004, blending Balkan brass, black metal aggression, and folk dance rhythms into a chaotic, humor-laced style often described as Balkan black metal. Their theatrical live shows and albums like Kaptein Kaos showcase their singular, genre-blurring approach.

name: Surprise Show
description: This slot is reserved for a surprise guest act, to be revealed closer to the date. Details of the performer and their musical style remain under wraps for now, promising an element of mystery and anticipation for attendees looking forward to the unannounced performance.

name: Fit For An Autopsy
description: Fit For An Autopsy are an American deathcore band formed in New Jersey in 2007, known for crushing breakdowns, blast-beat intensity, and socially conscious lyrics. Fronted by Joe Badolato, albums like The Sea of Tragic Beasts and Oh What the Future Holds cemented their standing in modern extreme metal.

name: Mushroomhead
description: Mushroomhead are an American band formed in Cleveland, Ohio in 1993, known for theatrical masked personas and a heavy fusion of nu metal, industrial, and electronic elements. Their layered, aggressive sound and elaborate stage identities, showcased on albums like XX, made them cult favorites well ahead of similar acts.

name: Blackbraid
description: Blackbraid is an American atmospheric black metal project founded by Sgah'gahsowah, of Mohawk/Akwesasne heritage, blending raw black metal ferocity with melodic passages and Indigenous American themes and imagery. Albums like Blackbraid I and Blackbraid II drew acclaim for their evocative nature-driven atmosphere and personal, cultural depth.

name: Saor
description: Saor is a Scottish atmospheric black metal project led by multi-instrumentalist Andy Marshall, blending sweeping black metal intensity with Celtic folk melodies, bagpipes, and fiddle. Active since 2012, albums such as Aura and Forgotten Paths have earned widespread praise for their emotive, landscape-inspired sound.

name: Fireborn
description: Fireborn is a German hard rock band fronted by vocalist Jenny, blending the energy of modern American hard rock with the soul of classic rock. Formerly known as Dislike Silence, the group released its debut album Reflections in 2023, followed by Dreamcatcher in 2026.

name: Broken By The Scream
description: Broken By The Scream are a Japanese kawaii metal group formed in Tokyo in 2016, fusing idol-style pop vocals with metalcore, djent, and deathcore intensity. Members trade guttural growls, high screams, and clean singing across their music, creating a distinctive hybrid that bridges J-pop idol culture and extreme metal.

name: Stam1na
description: Stam1na are a Finnish band formed in Vantaa in 2001, blending thrash metal aggression with progressive complexity and Finnish-language lyrics. Fronted by vocalist and guitarist Antti Hyyrynen, albums like Kylmyys and Viimeinen Atlantis have made them one of Finland's most respected and commercially successful heavy metal acts.

name: Rectal Smegma
description: Rectal Smegma are a Dutch goregrind band formed in Naaldwijk in 2003, delivering brutal, blast-beat-driven riffs paired with a humor-laced, party-oriented take on the genre. Extensive touring and albums such as To Serve and Protect have built them a dedicated following within the European grindcore and goregrind underground.

name: Filth
description: Filth is an American deathcore band from North Carolina known for a hip-hop-influenced take on the genre, pairing thick, downtuned riffs with brutal, intense breakdowns. The act channels aggressive, groove-laden extremity into a sound built for chaotic, high-energy live performances.

name: Mittel Alta
description: Mittel Alta are a German duo blending medieval folk melodies with modern hip-hop beats, a self-created style dubbed "Mittelalter-Rap." Known for crude, self-deprecating humor and a rowdy, drinking-song spirit, the project pairs metal and folk fans' sensibilities with rap delivery for a tongue-in-cheek take on medieval music.

name: Cryptopsy
description: Cryptopsy are a Canadian technical death metal band formed in Montreal in 1988, renowned for blistering musicianship, brutal intensity, and rapid stylistic evolution. Landmark albums such as None So Vile and Whisper Supremacy are considered genre classics, establishing them as pioneers of technical and brutal death metal.

name: Groza
description: Groza are a German black metal band formed in Bavaria in 2016, known for atmospheric, melody-driven songwriting that combines searing riffs, blast beats, and melancholic clean passages. Albums including Unified in Void, The Redemptive End, and Nadir have earned them recognition within the European atmospheric black metal scene.

name: Hindarfjäll
description: Hindarfjäll are a Swedish folk project founded in Gothenburg in 2015, blending ancient Nordic instrumentation and chant with contemporary heaviness to explore Norse mythology and nature. Their atmospheric, myth-steeped sound, heard on releases like Från Tidernas Begynnelse, channels Viking-era spirituality into a modern folk framework.

name: Kllsignl
description: Kllsignl is a dark electro-trap project from Munich, Germany, crafting unsettling, atmospheric music themed around sleep paralysis, intrusive thoughts, and nocturnal dread. Blending trap production with industrial and electronic textures, the project's eerie soundscapes occupy a dark, boundary-blurring space between electronic and heavy music.

name: Serpents
description: Serpents is a Polish act specializing in electronically refined, modern metal, pairing programmed textures and synth elements with hard-hitting, danceable riffs. The project blends heavy guitar work with electronic production for an energetic, contemporary sound suited to both headbanging and dance-floor movement.

name: I Am Your God
description: I Am Your God are a Finnish melodic death metal band formed in Rovaniemi in 2018, blending catchy Scandinavian melodies with heavy riffing in the tradition of Children of Bodom and In Flames. Albums including The Resurrection, SINister, and Δ (Trinity) have marked their rise in modern extreme metal.

name: Aesthetic Perfection
description: Aesthetic Perfection is an American electronic project founded by Daniel Graves in 2003, blending EBM, industrial, and synth-driven pop into a dark, dancefloor-ready sound. Known for provocative lyrics and energetic live performances, albums like All Beauty Destroyed and Into the Black established a strong presence in the industrial scene.

name: Warfield
description: Warfield is a German thrash metal band from Kaiserslautern, founded in 2012. The group plays fast-paced, catchy old-school thrash metal, channeling the genre's classic 1980s energy into tight, aggressive songwriting and an uncompromising, riff-driven live approach.

name: Katerfahrt
description: Katerfahrt are a German pirate folk band known for blending sea shanties, folk melodies and humorous, tongue-in-cheek lyrics into an energetic live show. Taking their audience on a musical voyage to the high seas, they combine catchy songwriting with a playful, larger-than-life stage persona rooted in nautical themes.

name: Nanowar Of Steel
description: Nanowar of Steel are an Italian power metal band formed in 2003, celebrated for merging technically accomplished heavy and power metal with sharp comedic lyrics that parody metal culture itself. Blending genuine musicianship with satire, they have built an international cult following through releases like "Stairway to Valhalla".

name: Das Lumpenpack
description: Das Lumpenpack is a German rock band from Mecklenburg-Vorpommern built around Jonas Frömming and Max Kennel. Mixing raw, uncompromising rock with punk energy and biting lyricism, they have become one of Germany's most prominent contemporary rock acts, drawing millions of streams and a devoted following.

name: Future Palace
description: Future Palace are a German band formed in Berlin in 2018 by vocalist Maria Lessing, guitarist Manuel Kohlert and drummer Johannes Früchtenicht. Blending metalcore and post-hardcore heaviness with anthemic alternative rock hooks and synth-pop textures, they craft emotionally driven songs anchored by Lessing's powerful, versatile vocal delivery.

name: Brothers Of Metal
description: Brothers of Metal are a Swedish power metal band formed in 2013, known for epic, bombastic songs steeped in Norse mythology. Fronted by dual vocalists Ylva Eriksson and Joacim Lundberg alongside Mats Lundgren, the band pairs soaring melodies and folk-tinged instrumentation with tales of gods, giants and Viking legend.

name: The Butcher Sisters
description: The Butcher Sisters are a German band formed in Mannheim in 2011, fusing crushing guitar riffs, aggressive German-language rap and beatdown hardcore grooves into a powerful, street-attuned sound. Their breakthrough album "Respekt und Robustheit" established them as a distinctive force on the German rap metal scene.

name: The Ghost Inside
description: The Ghost Inside are an American metalcore band from Orange County, California, formed in 2004. Known for melodic hardcore intensity and emotionally charged breakdowns, the band built acclaim with albums like "Get What You Give", and became renowned for their resilience after a devastating 2015 tour bus crash.

name: Lamb Of God
description: Lamb of God are an American groove metal band from Richmond, Virginia, formed in 1994. Renowned for thrash-infused riffing, pummeling grooves and vocalist Randy Blythe's ferocious delivery, the band became a defining force of modern American metal with albums such as "Ashes of the Wake" and "Sacrament".

name: Arch Enemy
description: Arch Enemy are a Swedish melodic death metal band formed in 1996 by guitarist Michael Amott. Known for blending aggressive death metal with soaring melodic leads, the band has been fronted by acclaimed vocalists including Angela Gossow and, currently, Alissa White-Gluz, and remains one of the genre's most influential acts.

name: Versengold
description: Versengold are a German medieval folk rock band from Kiel, formed in 2005. Combining traditional folk instrumentation such as bagpipes and flutes with driving rock arrangements, they perform lively, tavern-inspired songs that blend historical folk imagery with contemporary rock energy, earning a devoted following in the folk-rock scene.

name: Skindred
description: Skindred are a Welsh band formed in Newport in 1998, fronted by charismatic vocalist Benji Webbe. Pioneering a genre-defying fusion of reggae, ragga, dancehall, rap rock and metal, the band is celebrated for its infectious grooves, crowd-engaging anthems like "Warning" and its explosive, high-energy live performances.

name: Setyøursails
description: Setyøursails are a German metalcore band from Cologne, formed in 2017 by vocalist Jules Mitch and guitarist André Alves Rodrigues. Blending fierce metalcore aggression with melodic post-hardcore and themes of mental health and resilience, the band gained wide recognition through albums including "Nightfall" and "Bad Blood".

name: Brainstorm
description: Brainstorm are a German power metal band from Ravensburg, formed in 1989. Known for their technically sharp riffing, dramatic melodies and powerful vocal performances, the band has released a substantial discography over three decades and remains a respected mainstay of the European power metal scene.

name: Misery Index
description: Misery Index are an American death metal band from Baltimore, Maryland, formed in 2001. Combining technical death metal precision with the raw speed and aggression of grindcore, the band draws on politically charged lyrical themes and has built a strong reputation within the extreme metal underground.

name: Speed
description: Speed are a Japanese girl group formed in the late 1990s in Okinawa, emerging from the Okinawa Actors School. Blending J-Pop, dance-pop and R&B influences with polished vocal harmonies and choreography, the group achieved major commercial success with hits including "Body & Soul" and "White Love".

name: Unprocessed
description: Unprocessed are a German progressive metal band from Wiesbaden, formed in 2013. Known for technically demanding, genre-fluid songwriting that blends djent-influenced riffing with progressive metalcore and soaring melodic passages, the band has released albums including "Perception", "Covenant" and "Artificial Void".

name: Deicide
description: Deicide are an American death metal band from Tampa, Florida, formed in 1987 around frontman Glen Benton. Renowned for their blistering speed, dark, blasphemous lyrical themes and uncompromising sound, the band is regarded as one of the pioneering and most influential acts of the death metal genre.

name: Terror
description: Terror are an American hardcore punk band from Los Angeles, formed in 2002 and fronted by vocalist Scott Vogel. Known for their heavy, beatdown-driven hardcore sound and relentless touring ethic, the band has become one of the most influential and enduring acts in modern hardcore.

name: Der Weg Einer Freiheit
description: Der Weg einer Freiheit are a German atmospheric black metal band from Würzburg, formed in 2009. Known for combining raw black metal intensity with expansive, post-metal-influenced atmospheres and German-language lyrics, the band has earned critical acclaim as one of Germany's most distinctive extreme metal exports.

name: Deafheaven
description: Deafheaven are an American band from San Francisco, formed in 2010, widely credited with popularizing the blackgaze sound that merges black metal ferocity with the lush, melodic textures of shoegaze and post-metal. Their breakthrough album "Sunbather" earned widespread critical acclaim across metal and indie audiences alike.

name: Wolves In The Throne Room
description: Wolves in the Throne Room are an American atmospheric black metal band from Olympia, Washington, formed in 2003 by brothers Aaron and Nathan Weaver. Known for their immersive, nature-steeped sound blending raw black metal with ambient textures, the band has been influential in shaping the American black metal scene.

name: Zerre
description: Zerre are a German thrash metal band from Würzburg, formed in 2012 out of the city's hardcore scene. Combining the uncompromising, hard-hitting riffing of classic 1980s thrash with the raw aggression of hardcore punk, the band has drawn comparisons to Exodus and Power Trip through albums like "Scorched Souls".

name: Pridian
description: Pridian are a modern metal band from Tartu, Estonia, formed in 2018. Fusing fast, polyrhythmic grooves with massive, cinematic electronic elements, the band delivers an energetic and futuristic take on metalcore, drawing comparisons to genre-leading acts and building momentum through singles like "Hive Mind".

name: Luna Kills
description: Luna Kills are a Finnish band formed in 2019, blending alternative and nu-metal influences with electronic textures inspired by video game soundtracks. Known for heavy riffs paired with catchy, emotionally resonant melodies, the band made their mark with their debut full-length album "Deathmatch".

name: Brymir
description: Brymir are a Finnish symphonic melodic death metal band formed in 2008, known for blending soaring symphonic orchestration, folk-tinged melodies and aggressive death metal riffing. Drawing on fantasy and mythological themes, the band has built a reputation for grandiose, melodic songcraft within the Nordic metal scene.

name: Erdling
description: Erdling are a German Neue Deutsche Härte band formed in 2018, known for their striking forest-creature stage personas and imagery drawn from nature and folklore. Combining heavy, groove-laden riffs with melodic hooks and German lyrics, the band has quickly built a distinctive identity within the genre's new generation.

name: Blood Command
description: Blood Command are a Norwegian rock band from Bergen, formed in 2007. Blending punk rock energy with melodic hooks and post-hardcore intensity, the band is known for its dynamic, hard-hitting sound and spirited live shows, establishing itself as a notable act within Norway's punk and alternative rock scene.

name: Illdisposed
description: Illdisposed are a Danish death metal band from Aarhus, formed in 1991. Known for blending melodic death metal hooks with groove-laden heaviness and emotionally direct lyrics, the band has released an extensive discography over three decades and remains one of Denmark's longest-running and most respected extreme metal acts.

name: Ten56.
description: Ten56. is a French band formed in Lyon in 2018, blending nu metal, deathcore, and metalcore into an aggressive, modern sound. Fronted by vocalist Yosh, the group gained wide attention with its 2021 debut album 'Downfall of Iris', establishing itself quickly within Europe's heavy music scene.

name: Bizarrekult
description: Bizarrekult is the black metal project of Roman V., who began the music in his native Siberia, Russia before relocating to Norway, where the project found its momentum from 2019 onward. Blending raw, classic black metal with post-punk textures, the project released its acclaimed debut album 'Vi Overlever' in 2021.

name: Sun Eater
description: Sun Eater is an American stoner and psychedelic rock band hailing from Cincinnati, Ohio. Known for heavy, fuzzed-out riffs paired with hypnotic, trance-like grooves, the group draws on 1970s hard rock influences while carving out a modern, desert-tinged sound within the American underground rock scene.

name: Avalanche Effect
description: Avalanche Effect is a German metalcore band from Münster, known for exciting, modern metalcore that balances sing-along hooks with mosh-ready heaviness. The band's material, including the album Letters To My Future Self, showcases a contemporary, melodic take on the genre.

name: Heaven.exe
description: Heaven.exe is a Berlin-based act fusing raw, modern metal aggression with the cold, mechanical pulse of the city's techno and industrial electro underground. Drawing on Berlin's club culture, the project blends heaviness with hypnotic, machine-driven electronic textures.

name: Minus Youth
description: Minus Youth is a hardcore band from Stuttgart, Germany, known for brutal, groove-heavy hardcore delivered with high energy and technical precision. Equally capable of maximum groove or upbeat intensity, the band has built a reputation as a formidable force in Germany's hardcore scene.

name: Perchta
description: Perchta is an Austrian folk and black metal project named after the Alpine folklore figure of the same name. The music fuses harsh, atmospheric black metal with traditional folk instrumentation and Alpine mythology-inspired themes, creating a distinctive, wintry sound rooted in Austrian and Central European folklore.

name: Vulvarine
description: Vulvarine is an Austrian band blending rock, heavy metal, and punk rock into a raucous, high-energy hybrid. Known for a provocative name and irreverent attitude, the group brings a punchy, riff-heavy sound paired with a rebellious, tongue-in-cheek stage persona rooted in Austria's underground rock scene.

name: Heavysaurus
description: Heavysaurus is a German heavy metal band created specifically for children, with members performing in elaborate dinosaur costumes. Formed in the 2010s, the project introduces young fans to metal music through kid-friendly lyrics, playful themes, and accessible riffs, making heavy music approachable and fun for families.

name: Parasite Inc.
description: Parasite Inc. is a German melodic death metal band formed in Ludwigsburg in 2004. Combining technical riffing, soaring melodies, and aggressive vocals, the group has released several well-regarded albums that helped establish it as a respected name within Germany's modern melodic death metal community.

name: The Sons Of Huens
description: The Sons Of Huens are a German rock band from Mehnersmoos, known for a chaotic, irreverent approach that throws genre conventions aside in favor of irony and good-humored energy. The young act brings a circus-like unpredictability to its guitar-driven rock sound.

name: Kadavar
description: Kadavar is a German psychedelic and stoner rock trio formed in Berlin in 2010. Drawing heavily on 1970s hard rock aesthetics, the band is known for fuzzy guitar tones, driving grooves, and a retro visual style, earning acclaim across several albums as a leading act in the heavy psych revival.

name: Orbit Culture
description: Orbit Culture is a Swedish melodic death and groove metal band formed in Falkenberg in 2006. Known for tight, technical riffing combined with atmospheric, modern production, the band has steadily built an international following through relentless touring and consistently well-received studio releases.

name: Testament
description: Testament is an American thrash metal band formed in Berkeley, California, in 1983. Regarded as one of the genre's pioneering acts alongside the 'Big Four', the band, led by guitarist Eric Peterson and vocalist Chuck Billy, has released influential albums since their 1987 debut 'The Legacy'.

name: Alestorm
description: Alestorm is a Scottish folk and power metal band formed in Perth in 2004, celebrated for pioneering the tongue-in-cheek 'pirate metal' subgenre. Fronted by Christopher Bowes, the band blends symphonic keyboards, folk melodies, and metal riffs with humorous, seafaring lyrical themes across numerous studio albums.

name: Helloween
description: Helloween is a German power metal band formed in Hamburg in 1984, widely credited as a founding act of the power metal genre. Their landmark 'Keeper of the Seven Keys' albums in the late 1980s shaped the sound of countless bands, cementing their status as genre pioneers.

name: Thy Art Is Murder
description: Thy Art Is Murder is an Australian deathcore band formed in Sydney in 2006. Known for crushing breakdowns, technical guitar work, and uncompromising intensity, the group has become one of the leading international acts in modern deathcore through a string of critically acclaimed studio albums.

name: Soulbound
description: Soulbound is a German band merging industrial metal, gothic metal, and metalcore into a heavy, atmospheric hybrid. Combining electronic textures with crushing guitar work and dark, emotive songwriting, the act represents the modern wave of genre-blending metal emerging from Germany's active heavy music scene.

name: Sanguisugabogg
description: Sanguisugabogg is an American brutal death metal band formed in Columbus, Ohio, in 2019. Known for gritty, slam-influenced riffs, guttural vocals, and grotesque lyrical themes, the group quickly rose within the underground death metal scene through raw, punishing studio releases and intense live shows.

name: Bloodred Hourglass
description: Bloodred Hourglass is a Finnish melodic death and thrash metal band formed in Kuopio in 2009. Known for combining aggressive riffing with melodic, hook-laden songwriting, the group has released multiple albums that established them as a notable act in Finland's modern metal scene.

name: Municipal Waste
description: Municipal Waste is an American crossover thrash band formed in Richmond, Virginia, in 2001. Known for breakneck tempos, gang vocals, and a comedic, beer-soaked approach to classic thrash and hardcore, the band has become a leading force in the crossover thrash revival since the mid-2000s.

name: Thundermother
description: Thundermother is a Swedish hard rock band formed in Gothenburg in 2009 by guitarist Filippa Nassil. Known for a classic, riff-driven hard rock sound reminiscent of 1970s and 80s greats, the all-female act has built a strong international reputation through relentless touring and energetic performances.

name: Decapitated
description: Decapitated is a Polish death metal band formed in Krosno in 1996, recognized for pioneering technical death metal with their acclaimed debut 'Winds of Creation'. Combining intricate musicianship with brutal intensity, the band has remained one of Poland's most influential extreme metal exports for decades.

name: Soulfly
description: Soulfly is an American groove and nu metal band founded in Phoenix, Arizona, in 1997 by guitarist and vocalist Max Cavalera, formerly of Sepultura. The band fuses heavy groove riffing with tribal rhythms and global influences, releasing numerous albums since their self-titled 1998 debut.

name: Paleface Swiss
description: Paleface Swiss is a Swiss beatdown hardcore and deathcore band known for crushing breakdowns, low-tuned riffs, and an aggressive, violent sound. Representing Switzerland's heavier hardcore scene, the group combines hardcore's raw intensity with the technical brutality of modern deathcore.

name: Soen
description: Soen is a Swedish progressive metal band formed in 2004 by drummer Martin Lopez, formerly of Opeth, alongside bassist Steve DiGiorgio. Blending atmospheric, melodic songwriting with heavy, progressive instrumentation, the band has released several critically praised albums exploring introspective and socially conscious themes.

name: Inner Space
description: Inner Space is a hardcore band from Leipzig, Germany, known for hateful, hard-hitting hardcore built around brutality and heavy breakdowns, balanced with catchy, driving songwriting. The act channels raw aggression into an intense, high-energy live sound rooted in Germany's hardcore underground.

name: Skeleton Pit
description: Skeleton Pit is a German thrash metal band drawing on the genre's classic, riff-heavy foundations. Known for fast, aggressive playing and raw energy, the act represents Germany's enduring thrash metal tradition, delivering hard-hitting songs rooted in the sound's 1980s underground origins.

name: Wucan
description: Wucan is a German rock band from Dresden formed in 2011 around singer, flautist and guitarist Francis Tobolsky. Blending 1970s-inspired blues rock, stoner and psychedelic influences with prominent flute lines, the band draws frequent comparisons to Jethro Tull and Black Sabbath across three studio albums.

name: Haggefugg
description: Haggefugg are a Cologne-based German folk rock outfit active since 2015, fusing medieval-inspired melodies, bagpipes and rock instrumentation into what they call playful party rock. Known for high-energy live shows and irreverent wordplay, the six-piece has built a following through relentless touring and support slots for established folk-rock acts.

name: Cabal
description: Cabal is a Danish deathcore band from Copenhagen, formed in 2015. Fusing hardcore and metalcore aggression with crushing breakdowns and ambient textures, the band built its reputation with the 2018 debut Mark of Rot before signing to Nuclear Blast, releasing acclaimed albums including Magno Interitus and Everything Rots.

name: Manntra
description: Manntra is a Croatian folk metal band from Umag, formed in 2011 by former Omega Lithium members Marko Matijević Sekul and Zoltan Lečei. Combining traditional Croatian folk instruments like the sopele and tamburica with industrial-tinged heavy rock, the prolific act has released multiple studio albums exploring mythology and folklore themes.

name: 200 Stab Wounds
description: 200 Stab Wounds is an American death metal band from Cleveland, Ohio, founded in 2019. Blending traditional death metal with hardcore and thrash influences, the band gained rapid attention with 2021's Slave to the Scalpel and 2024's Manual Manic Procedures, released via Metal Blade Records.

name: Slomosa
description: Slomosa is a stoner rock band from Bergen, Norway, established in 2016. Blending fuzzed-out desert rock riffs, grungy hooks and a punk edge inspired by Queens of the Stone Age and Soundgarden, the band's self-titled debut and follow-up Tundra Rock earned them a Spellemannsprisen award and wide European touring exposure.

name: Møl
description: Møl is a Danish atmospheric black metal band from Aalborg, formed in 2013. Merging blast-beat intensity with shoegaze textures and post-metal dynamics, the quintet drew international acclaim with their 2018 debut Jord and follow-up Diorama, establishing themselves among Europe's leading acts in the blackgaze scene.

name: Rodscha A. Kambodscha U. Tom Palme
description: Rodscha A. Kambodscha und Tom Palme are a German musical duo known for lively, interactive songs blending folk, pop and playful rhythms. Active since the early 2000s, they have built a devoted following through energetic performances, audience participation and a warm, good-humored approach to their craft.

name: Randale
description: Randale is a German rock band known for energetic, guitar-driven songs delivered in the German language. Drawing on punk-inflected rock traditions, the group combines catchy hooks with a raw, spirited live approach that has earned them a loyal following within the German-language rock scene.

name: Plume
description: Plume is a German electronic rock quartet from Munich, formed in 2020 and fronted by vocalist Pascal Pashaee. Fusing pop songwriting with electronic textures, distorted riffs and fractured rhythms, the band released its debut album SAFEROOMS & HEALING FREQUENCIES in 2026.

name: Blacktoothed
description: Blacktoothed is a German rock band from Leipzig, formed in 2007 originally as Black Tooth Scares. Mixing 1980s-influenced hard rock with modern metal and pop sensibilities, the trio released their debut Seeker in 2018, followed by Juli and Headway on Arising Empire, showcasing an emotionally driven, melodic songwriting approach.

name: Hopsydian
description: Hopsydian is an Italian metalcore band from Milan formed in 2024, fronted by vocalist Myles Idolo. Fusing modern metalcore power with post-hardcore urgency, cinematic atmosphere and chant-ready choruses, the young act quickly gained momentum with their debut EP A Graceful Sin and festival appearances alongside established genre names.

name: Lost In Hollywood
description: Lost in Hollywood is a German metalcore band from Hamburg, formed in 2023. Combining powerful riffs, emotional clean vocals and haunting breakdowns, the quartet released their debut album The Beauty of Death within a year of forming, before signing to Arising Empire and building momentum with subsequent singles.

name: Phantom Corporation
description: Phantom Corporation is a German death metal and crust punk band formed in 2016, uniting scene veterans from Bremen and Dortmund with members of Dew-Scented, Eroded and Obscenity. Their sound merges d-beat crust, punishing death metal and old-school thrash, culminating in their 2023 debut album Fallout.

name: Hæresis
description: Hæresis is an atmospheric black and post-metal band from Berlin, Germany, formed in 2016. Balancing raw intensity with ethereal, immersive atmospheres, the band released their debut full-length Si Vis Pacem Para Bellum in 2025, known for intense live performances that fuse light and sound.

name: Hangatyr
description: Hangatyr is a German black metal band from Bad Sulza, Thuringia, formed in 2006. Named after one of Odin's titles in Norse mythology, the group blends heathen and Nordic-inspired black metal with influences from 1990s Norwegian scenes across albums including Kalt and Sumpf der Fäule.

name: Fleshless
description: Fleshless is a Czech death metal and grindcore band from Děčín, active since 1993 under this name following earlier roots as Zvrator. Over three decades the band has evolved from raw death/grind into melodic and brutal death metal, releasing nine studio albums and performing extensively across the international underground scene.

name: Cytotoxin
description: Cytotoxin is a German technical and brutal death metal band known for hyper-precise, downtuned riffing and blistering musicianship. Combining relentless speed with intricate song structures, the band has built a reputation within the European death metal underground for technically demanding, high-energy studio releases and live performances.

name: Candlemass
description: Candlemass is a Swedish epic doom metal band from Stockholm, formed in 1984 and widely regarded as pioneers of the epic doom subgenre. Known for the landmark album Epicus Doomicus Metallicus and decades of lineup changes, the band remains one of doom metal's most influential acts.

name: Seconddeath
description: Seconddeath is a German death metal band from the Hoyerswerda region of Saxony. Notable for performing predominantly in German rather than English, the band delivers a raw, regionally rooted take on death metal and has built a following through consistent live performances at metal festivals across eastern Germany.

name: Brachlant
description: Brachlant is a German black metal band from Delitzsch, Saxony, originally formed in 2003 as a melodic death/thrash act before transitioning to black metal. The band's evolving sound reflects two decades in the German extreme metal underground, with recent releases including the album Minus.

name: Victim
description: Victim is a German thrash metal band from Weimar, Thuringia, dedicated to the raw, aggressive sound of 1980s thrash metal. Drawing on classic genre influences, the band delivers high-energy riffing and old-school attitude, maintaining an active presence within Germany's traditional thrash metal underground.

name: Horresque
description: Horresque is a German blackened death metal band formed in 2015, originally from Limburg and later based in Mainz. Their name, a blend of 'horrific' and 'grotesque,' reflects a sound built on double-guitar melodies and relentless drumming, exploring lyrical themes of human atrocity across two full-length albums.

name: Graceless
description: Graceless is a Dutch death/doom metal band from Leiden, formed in 2016 by former Soulburn members Eric Daniels and Bob Bagchus. Drawing on the crushing, old-school sound of bands like Autopsy and Bolt Thrower, the group has released four full-length albums, most recently Icons of Ruin via Listenable Records.

name: Bodyfarm
description: Bodyfarm is a Dutch death metal band from Amersfoort, founded in 2009 by Quint Meerbeek and Thomas Wouters. Delivering groove-laden, old-school death metal informed by both American and Scandinavian traditions, the band has released five full-length albums since their acclaimed 2012 debut Malevolence.

name: Maerer
description: Mærer is a German experimental post-black and doom metal collective from Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, formed in 2021. Drawing on myths, sagas and dark folklore for its narrative concept, the project weaves crushing, atmospheric melodies into a bleak, immersive sound across a series of conceptually linked EPs.

name: Soul Grinder
description: Soul Grinder is a German death metal band from Bremen, formed in 2018. Influenced by Vomitory, Bolt Thrower and Suffocation, the trio delivers old-school death metal with Swedish-style riffing and modern production, having released multiple EPs and full-lengths including Chronicles of Decay and Frozen Halls.

name: Irem
description: Irem is a German black/death metal band from Halle and Leipzig, Saxony-Anhalt, formed in 2003. Known for fast, melodic yet sinister and punishing songwriting, the band explores themes of blasphemy and darkness across albums including Prophecy of Doom and Obscuritas Aeterna as an independent act.

name: Agathodaimon
description: Agathodaimon is a German black metal band formed in 1995, known for blending dark, symphonic and melodic elements into their sound. Across multiple studio albums and lineup changes, the band has remained a fixture of the German extreme metal scene, pairing atmospheric keyboards with aggressive riffing.

name: Psychonaut 4
description: Psychonaut 4 is a depressive black metal band from Tbilisi, Georgia, formed in 2010. Their lyrics confront depression, personal struggle and tragedy, increasingly delivered in Georgian alongside English. The band has released five studio albums, most recently ...of Mourning in 2024, cementing their place in the DSBM scene.

name: Melechesh
description: Melechesh is a black metal band originally formed in Jerusalem in 1993, now based internationally. Renowned for pioneering a Mesopotamian and Middle Eastern-themed strand of black metal, the band fuses occult and ancient Near Eastern imagery with aggressive riffing across acclaimed albums including Emissaries and The Epigenesis.

name: Berserkr
description: Thunderous Norwegian folk-metal quartet drawing on saga poetry and battle-march drum patterns. Their live shows close with a wall of horn calls.

name: Bjornholm
description: Atmospheric black-metal duo from the Faroe Islands. Glacial guitars and clean baritone vocals over slow, deliberate rhythms.

name: Drekka Sjór
description: Icelandic post-rock with rune-based song titles and an obsession for nine-minute crescendos.

name: Frost Giants
description: Six-piece pagan-folk ensemble. Nyckelharpa, frame drums, throat-singing and a stage built around a forge anvil.

name: Mjölnir Mark
description: Power-trio playing thunder-soaked stoner rock. Riffs broad enough to drag a longship across a dry beach.

name: Ragnar's Wrath
description: Crossover thrash from Gothenburg with hardcore breakdowns and a frontman who circles the pit barefoot.

name: Skalds of Asgard
description: Acoustic story-singers performing skaldic verse. Two voices, lyre, bone flute, no amplification beyond a single ribbon mic.

name: Valkyrjar
description: All-female symphonic metal sextet. Choral vocals, twin guitars, harp, and a stage show punctuated by spear-dancing.

name: Yggdrasil's Roots
description: Earth-toned doom from the Black Forest. Glacially slow, organ-driven, and best heard at sunset.

name: Ironveil
description: Dark atmospheric post-black metal from the Norwegian highlands. Cascading tremolo riffs dissolve into drone passages that feel carved from glacier ice.

name: Shieldwall
description: Battle-hardened crust-punk from Copenhagen. Four-chord ferocity meets marching-drum thunder — the kind of band that starts a wall of death with a single glare.

name: Tidecaller
description: Dark-wave duo from the Shetland Islands. Synth bass and reverb-drenched vocals summon storms from behind a wall of fog machines.

name: Skullberg
description: Finnish Viking death metal with pinch harmonics you feel three rows back. Epic song structures last well past the ten-minute mark.

name: Nordheim
description: Symphonic Viking metal flagship from Oslo. A thirty-piece touring string section, operatic baritone, and a stage lit entirely by fire baskets.

name: Eitr's Venom
description: Sludge-doom quartet from Hamburg. Feedback-drenched walls of sound played at the tempo of a dying tide.

name: Galdrastafr
description: One-man ritual dark ambient project. Live sets involve handmade stave instruments, bone percussion, and field recordings from Icelandic lava fields.

name: Ashen Völva
description: Ethereal goth duo from Stockholm. Cello-driven soundscapes weave through whispered prophecy poetry and cinematic percussion.

name: Grimnir's Pyre
description: Melodic death metal from Aarhus. Soaring guitar harmonies contrast with guttural vocals recounting tales of the hanged god.

name: Wyrdweavers
description: Medieval folk ensemble from Canterbury. Bagpipes, rebec, and tabor drum wrapped in haunting three-part harmony.

name: Embla's Kin
description: Neo-folk duo from the Black Forest. Acoustic guitar, mountain dulcimer, and two voices that sound like they were born from the same root.

name: Óðinn's Eye
description: Progressive metal quintet from Helsinki. Time-signature games, extended improvisations, and a fifteen-minute centrepiece suite in every set.

name: Skaldenfang
description: Folk-punk band from Malmö. Rowdy crowd participation, accordion breakdowns, and enough mead-hall energy to empty a keg in a single set.

name: Draugar
description: Funeral doom from Bergen. Playing tempo measured in decades, the band summons a grief so dense it has its own gravity.

name: Fimbulwolf
description: Blackened war-metal trio from Trondheim built around wolf-howl vocal samples, blast-beat sieges, and a live rig assembled from repurposed shipping containers.

name: Thronecult
description: Thronecult is a German black metal band from Mylau, Saxony, formerly known as Cold Palace before adopting their current name in 2019. Playing raw, occult black metal rooted in the early-1990s tradition, the independent act released Essence of Eternity in 2022 and Human Decay in 2026.

name: Borknagar
description: Borknagar is a Norwegian black metal band formed in 1995, celebrated for fusing progressive songwriting, folk influences and nature-themed lyricism with extreme metal intensity. Featuring a rotating cast of notable Norwegian musicians over the years, the band has released numerous influential albums exploring Nordic mythology.

name: Senntus
description: Senntus is an Austrian dark metal band from Leoben, Styria, founded in 2011 by Jürgen Mayr as a solo studio project before expanding into a five-piece live band. Blending melodic black and gothic metal influences, the group explores themes of death and mental illness across releases like Herzlfresser.

name: Servant
description: Servant is a German black metal band from Münden, Lower Saxony, formed in 2021 and signed to AOP Records. Delivering richly melodic black metal rooted in the 1990s second wave with post-black metal touches, the band has released several acclaimed albums including Death Devil Magick and Lux Ex Inferis.

name: Black Sails
description: Sea-shanty hardcore with mandolin and trumpet. The headliner everyone leaves the merch tent for.

name: Runecaster
description: Swedish folk-metal trio weaving elder runic verse into their lyrics. A hurdy-gurdy player doubles on lap steel for extended interlude pieces.

name: Stormwulf
description: Raw black metal from northern Finland. No stage lighting, no banter — just blast beats erupting from the darkness.

name: Serpent's Wake
description: Post-metal five-piece from Rotterdam. Songs build patiently for twelve minutes before collapsing into thunderous release.

name: Helbound
description: Traditional doom metal from Birmingham. Slow, crushing riffs and reverb-soaked vocals in the grand tradition of the genre's birthplace.

name: Blóðörn
description: Extreme metal project from Reykjavik. Intense, technical, and lyrically rooted in blood-eagle mythology. Not for the faint-hearted.

name: Thunderhide
description: Heavy-rock power trio from Cologne. Stoner grooves, fuzz-drenched bass, and a drummer with a kick-drum pattern that rattles loose fillings.

name: Towards the Sinister
description: Towards the Sinister is a project formed in 2026 by founding My Dying Bride members Aaron Stainthorpe (vocals), Calvin Robertshaw (guitar), Ade Jackson (bass) and Rick Miah (drums), joined by additional musicians. The band performs material from My Dying Bride's earliest releases, including As the Flower Withers and Turn Loose the Swans.

name: Dödsrit
description: Dödsrit are a black metal and crust band formed in 2017 by Christoffer Öster, based between Borlänge, Sweden and Amsterdam, Netherlands. The band blends atmospheric black metal with the rawness of d-beat crust punk, with lyrics addressing social and political themes.

name: Asphagor
description: Asphagor are an Austrian extreme metal band from Angerberg, Tyrol, formed in 2007. The band blends black, death and progressive metal elements across albums including Havoc, Anti, The Cleansing and Pyrogenesis.

name: Bianca
description: Bianca are an Italian black metal band from Rome, formed in 2024 and featuring members of Hideous Divinity and Nocturnal Depression. Self-described as "oneiric black metal," the band explores themes of dreams and the unconscious, and released their self-titled debut album via Avantgarde Music.

name: Emperor
description: Emperor are a Norwegian black metal band formed in 1991 in Notodden by Ihsahn and Samoth. Pioneers of a symphonic, orchestral approach to black metal, they became one of the genre's most influential acts with albums such as In the Nightside Eclipse and Anthems to the Welkin at Dusk.

name: Primordial
description: Primordial are an Irish extreme metal band from County Dublin, fronted by vocalist Alan "Nemtheanga" Averill since the early 1990s. Their sound fuses black and doom metal with Celtic folk influences, exploring themes of Irish history and mythology across albums such as Imrama and The Gathering Wilderness.

name: Ellende
description: Ellende is an Austrian atmospheric black metal project founded in Graz in 2011 by multi-instrumentalist L.G. as a solo studio project, later expanded into a live act. The project's melancholic, introspective sound incorporates classical instrumentation such as strings and piano alongside its post-black metal atmosphere.

name: Naglfar
description: Naglfar are a Swedish black metal band from Umeå, formed in 1992 by Jens Rydén and Kristoffer Olivius. The band combines aggressive black metal with melodic and symphonic elements and takes its name from the ship of the dead in Norse mythology.

name: Wind Rose
description: Italian folk/power metal band from Pisa, Tuscany, formed in 2009, celebrated for their Tolkien-inspired "dwarven metal" sound and the viral hit "Diggy Diggy Hole." Their sixth album, Trollslayer, arrived in October 2024.

name: Unviâr
description: Atmospheric black metal act from Italy's Friuli-Venezia Giulia region, whose name means "winter" in the Friulian language. Their music draws on the region's overlapping Celtic, Germanic, Slavic and Latin heritage, most recently on the 2025 debut full-length Disglaç.

name: Svarttjern
description: Norwegian black metal band from Oslo, formed in 2003 by musicians also tied to Carpathian Forest and Ragnarok. Their name, meaning "black tarn," is taken from a 19th-century Norwegian painting, and the band records for Soulseller Records.

name: Nytt Land
description: Russian ritual dark-folk duo from Kalachinsk, Siberia, founded by husband and wife Anatoly and Natalya Pakhalenko in 2013. Their music combines throat singing and handmade instruments like the talharpa and kantele with texts drawn from the Poetic Edda.

name: Nordjevel
description: Norwegian black metal band founded in 2015 by Doedsadmiral, whose members are also known from Ragnarok, Myrkskog and Dark Funeral. Signed to Season of Mist, the band has released three full-length albums, most recently Gnavhòl in 2022.

name: Nocte Obducta
description: German avant-garde black metal band formed in Mainz in 1993, known for technically ambitious songwriting paired with melancholic, highly poetic German-language lyrics. After a mid-2000s hiatus the band resumed activity in 2010 and remains a major influence on the German black metal scene.

name: Miserere Luminis
description: Canadian atmospheric black metal band from Montreal, formed in 2008 by musicians also active in Gris and Sombres Forêts, key groups of the Québécois underground black metal scene. Their most recent full-length, Sidera, was released in March 2026.

name: Malphas
description: Swiss occult black metal band from Lausanne, formed in 2014. In 2027 the band toured Europe alongside Nordjevel, Svarttjern and Unviâr as part of Nordjevel's Incantation Tour.

name: Kalmah
description: Finnish melodic death metal band from Oulu, formed in 1998 and quickly signed to Spinefarm Records. Known for aggressive yet melodic riffing with folk and "swamp metal" touches, the band's name is Karelian for "to the grave."

name: Graveworm
description: Italian symphonic/gothic black metal band from Brunico, South Tyrol, formed in 1992 and signed to AFM Records. Their sound blends orchestral, keyboard-driven arrangements with black and death metal aggression across a long-running discography.

name: Eldamar
description: Norwegian atmospheric black metal project from Askim, started as a solo endeavor in 2015 and inspired by J.R.R. Tolkien, heathenism and nature. The project has since grown into a touring live band.

name: Battlelore
description: Finnish epic fantasy metal band from Lappeenranta formed in 1999, known for lyrics and stage shows built around J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle-earth. After a long hiatus the band returned with the album The Return of the Shadow in 2022.

name: Asenblut
description: German pagan black/thrash metal band from Göttingen, formed in 2006 and regarded as an early force in the German folk/pagan metal scene. Their name combines "Asen" (Aesir) and "Blut" (blood), reflecting the Norse-mythology themes that run through their work.

name: All for Metal
description: German-Italian power/true metal band founded in 2022 by Tetzel (also of Asenblut) and Antonio "Amerigo" Calanna. Known for epic anthems built around Norse mythology and war, their debut album Legends arrived in 2023 via AFM Records.

name: Vintersorg
description: Swedish one-man project of Andreas Hedlund, active since 1994 and rooted in black metal before expanding into Viking, folk and progressive metal. Lyrically the project explores heathenism, nature, astronomy and philosophy across a long, genre-shifting discography.

name: Thron
description: German melodic black metal band from Baden-Württemberg, formed in 2015 and signed to Listenable Records. Their fast, atmospheric sound draws on second-wave forerunners such as Dissection and Dimmu Borgir, with lyrics centered on mythology and religion.

name: Tabernis
description: Enigmatic dark medieval folk duo, Noxifer and Umbrae, who perform masked as beekeepers playing davul and bagpipe. Signed to Napalm Records, they released their debut album Seasons of the Dark Hive in 2026 and have already played major festivals including Wacken and Summer Breeze.

name: Fimbul Winter
description: Swedish melodic death metal band whose members carry extensive experience from acts connected to Amon Amarth. A recent formation, they debuted with the EP What Once Was in September 2025.

name: Bloodbark
description: Anonymous atmospheric black metal project of undisclosed origin, signed to Northern Silence Productions. Releases including Bonebranches and 2025's Sacred Sound of Solitude favor mournful, minor-key songwriting blending black metal, blackgaze and post-rock.

name: Anomalie
description: Austrian atmospheric post-black metal band from Leobendorf, Lower Austria, formed in 2011. Their sound blends melancholic atmosphere with raw black metal aggression.

name: A Forest Of Stars
description: English avant-garde black metal band from Leeds, formed in 2007. Their sound blends black metal with folk, art rock and psychedelic elements, and the band has released albums including The Corpse of Rebirth and Beware the Sword You Cannot See.

name: Deathless Void
description: Death/black metal band from Amsterdam, Netherlands, signed to Iron Bonehead Productions. The band debuted with a self-titled EP in 2022 and released the full-length The Voluptuous Fire of Sin in 2024.

name: Merrimack
description: Black metal band from Paris, France, formed in 1994 by guitarist Amfortas. Merrimack were among the first black metal bands to perform in Paris and have released albums including Of Entropy and Life Denial (2006) and Of Grace and Gravity (2024).

name: Nemorous
description: Atmospheric black metal band from North East England, formed in 2018 by former members of Wodensthrone. Signed to Bindrune Recordings, Nemorous released their self-titled debut in 2021 and What Remains When Hope Has Failed in 2025.

name: Nexion
description: Black/death metal band from Reykjavík, Iceland, formed in 2016 and signed to Avantgarde Music. Nexion's lineup includes musicians formerly of Svartidauði and Sólstafir, and their releases include Seven Oracles (2020) and Sundrung (2025).

name: Panzerfaust
description: Black metal band from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, formed in 2005. Panzerfaust have released albums including Jehovah-Jireh: The Divine Anti-logos (2013) and The Suns of Perdition series, and toured with acts such as Marduk and Slayer.

name: Bölzer
description: Extreme metal duo from Zürich, Switzerland, formed in 2008 by Okoi Jones and Fabian Wyrsch. Bölzer's acclaimed early EPs and their 2016 debut album Hero blend black and death metal with unconventional song structures.

name: Horn
description: One-man black metal project from Paderborn, Germany, active since 2002. Led by Nerrath (Niklas Thiele), Horn combines a classicist, nature-themed black metal style with pagan and folkloric lyrical themes across albums such as Turm am Hang.

name: Schammasch
description: Avant-garde black metal band from Basel, Switzerland, formed in 2009 and named after the Mesopotamian sun god Šamaš. Schammasch combine black metal with doom and Hermetic mysticism across albums such as Triangle (2016) and Hearts of No Light (2019).

name: Phosphorus
description: Blackened post-metal band from Sankt Wendel in south-west Germany. The current line-up features Aaron Feller, Florian Schütz, Aline Emge and Lukas Scherer, and the band released its debut album Frail Grasp of Broken Hands in 2025.

name: Sumerian Tombs
description: Black metal band from Cologne, Germany, formed in 2020, playing what they describe as epic vampyric black metal drawing on Sumerian mythology. Signed to Ván Records, Sumerian Tombs released their self-titled debut in 2022 and Age of Eternal Night in 2025.

name: The Spirit
description: Black/death metal band from Saarbrücken, Germany, formed in 2015 around Matthias Trautes and drummer Manuel Steitz (ex-Agathodaimon). The Spirit are signed to AOP Records and released Songs Against Humanity in 2024.

name: Darvaza
description: International black metal project formed in 2015 by Italian multi-instrumentalist Omega and Norwegian vocalist Wraath (Tsjuder). Their raw, hypnotic sound has been released via Terratur Possessions, culminating in the 2022 album Ascending Into Perdition.

name: Détresse
description: Black metal band formed in 2023 as a collaboration between musicians from Austria and Québec, Canada. Détresse released their debut album Pessimismes in 2025 via Vendetta Records.

name: Helleruin
description: One-man black metal project from Groningen, Netherlands, active since 2015. Written and performed entirely by Niels Kuiper (Carchost), Helleruin's albums include War Upon Man (2021) and Devils, Death and Dark Arts (2023).

name: The Great Sea
description: Black metal duo from North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, formed in 2022 by J.R. (Long Distance Calling) and S.H. (Ordeal & Plight). The Great Sea released their debut album Noble Art of Desolation via AOP Records in 2025.

name: Carpathian Forest
description: Carpathian Forest are a Norwegian black metal band formed in the early 1990s by Nattefrost and Nordavind under the name Enthrone. Known for a raw, nihilistic take on old-school Scandinavian black metal steeped in Satanism, misanthropy and dark humor, they built cult status through early demos before signing to Avantgarde and later Season of Mist.

name: Reil Of Violence
description: Reil of Violence is a German speed/thrash metal project formed in December 2023 by Kreator drummer Jürgen "Ventor" Reil together with his son Jerome and Tim Reil. The three-generation family project grew out of a Rock Hard magazine interview that first suggested the idea to father and son.

name: Urgehal
description: Urgehal are a Norwegian black metal band formed in Hønefoss in 1992 by Trondr Nefas and Enzifer. Playing raw, Satanic black metal in the classic Norwegian tradition, they released their debut Arma Christi in 1997 and several further albums before splitting in 2016, occasionally reuniting for live shows since.

name: Warhammer
description: Warhammer are a black/death metal band from Athens, Greece, formed in 2012 by George Tsavdaridis and Hercules Giotis. The band began as a thrash metal act before shifting toward a heavier black/death metal sound starting with 2021's Ashes and Cinders, an album that also introduced saxophone into their live and studio sound.

name: Hexer
description: Hexer are a blackened doom/sludge metal band from Germany, formed in 2014 with members also known from Imha Tarikat and Eyemaster. Their sound blends slow, heavy doom and sludge with black and death metal elements and occult themes, as heard on albums including Cosmic Doom Ritual (2017) and Abyssal (2023).

name: Tsatthoggua
description: Tsatthoggua are a black/thrash metal band from Marl, Germany, formed in 1993 and named after a deity from H.P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos. Their 1996 debut Hosanna Bizarre, released on Osmose Productions, made them a cult act in the German extreme metal underground; the original lineup reunited in 2019 and released We Are God in 2024.

name: Antipeewee
description: Antipeewee are a thrash metal band from Abensberg, Bavaria, Germany, formed in 2006 and drawing on the tradition of 1980s German underground thrash. Signed to Slash Zero Records, their releases include Human Grill Party, Madness Unleashed and Infected by Evil, with lyrical themes spanning Cthulhu mythos, politics and partying.

name: Paxtilence
description: Paxtilence are a thrash metal band from Nuremberg, Germany, founded in 2011 to bring riff-driven, aggressive thrash inspired by Kreator and Megadeth to the local scene. They have released the Cyclotomic Warfare EP (2017) and the album Wildfire (2022), followed by a live release, Live in Höred (2026).

name: Destruction
description: Destruction are a German thrash metal band formed in 1982 in Weil am Rhein, led since inception by bassist/vocalist Marcel "Schmier" Schirmer and guitarist Mike Sifringer. Alongside Kreator, Sodom and Tankard, they are considered one of the "Big Four" of Teutonic thrash metal, with genre-defining albums including 1985's Infernal Overkill and 1988's Release from Agony.

name: Exumer
description: Exumer are a German thrash metal band formed in Wiesbaden in 1985 by singer/bassist Mem V. Stein and guitarist Ray Mensh. Their 1986 debut Possessed by Fire became an underground classic; after splitting in 1991 the band reactivated in 2008 and continues to release new material, including 2026's Death Mask Messiah on Metal Blade Records.

name: Mortem
description: Mortem are a Norwegian extreme metal band from Oslo, formed in 1987 by Marius Vold and Steinar Sverd Johnsen as one of the earliest black metal acts to emerge in Norway. Their influential Slow Death demo was produced by Mayhem's Euronymous, and after members went on to found Arcturus and Thorns, the band reactivated in 2018 and released the Peaceville Records album Ravnsvart in 2019, featuring Mayhem's Hellhammer on drums.

name: Graven
description: Graven are a black metal band from Memmingen, Bavaria, Germany, formed in 1999 out of the earlier band Totenreich. Signed to Undercover Records, their lyrics center on hate, darkness, death and misanthropy across albums including Perished and Forgotten (2002) and The Shadows Eternal Call (2005).

name: Chemicide
description: Chemicide are a thrash metal band from San José, Costa Rica, formed in 2008 (initially as Conqueror) and drawing comparisons to Kreator, Destruction and Demolition Hammer. Signed to Listenable Records, they released their latest full-length, Violence Prevails, in 2025.

name: Sirens
description: Sirens are a two-piece heavy/speed/power metal band from Ansbach, Bavaria, Germany, active since 1995. Independent and self-releasing, their lyrics span fantasy and social themes, with their most recent full-length, In Goat We Trust, released in April 2025.

name: Desaster
description: Desaster are a German black/thrash metal band from Koblenz, formed in 1988 and active since 1989, taking their name from Destruction's song "Total Desaster." Blending black, death and thrash influences drawn from Venom, Hellhammer and Mayhem, they have released ten studio albums on Metal Blade Records, including 2025's Kill All Idols.

name: Summer Breeze Legends & Orchestra
description: A one-off 30th-anniversary special: an all-star ensemble backed by a 40-piece line-up of the Leipzig Philharmoniker performing career-defining metal anthems across a 2.5-hour show. Musically directed and arranged by Lord of the Lost frontman Chris Harms together with composer Corvin Bahn; the specific guest vocalists are set to be revealed in December 2026.

name: Electric Callboy
description: German party-metal juggernaut from Castrop-Rauxel, founded in 2010 and known as Eskimo Callboy until 2022. Blending heavy breakdowns with euphoric electronic/trance production, the band became one of the genre's biggest international crossover successes of the 2020s.

name: Edguy
description: German melodic power metal band formed in Fulda in 1992 by then-14-year-old Tobias Sammet, Jens Ludwig, Dominik Storch and Dirk Sauer. A mainstay of the European power metal scene for over three decades, Edguy is playing only a handful of 2027 farewell shows.

name: Saltatio Mortis
description: German medieval folk-rock band from Karlsruhe, formed in 2000 as a street-music act before becoming one of the pioneers of the German "Mittelalter" movement that fuses lutes and bagpipes with big rock songs. The band has landed multiple number-one albums in Germany.

name: Children of Bodom
description: Finnish melodic death metal band from Espoo, formed in 1993 (as Inearthed until 1996) and one of Finland's best-selling metal exports. The band split in 2019 following frontman Alexi Laiho's death but reunited in 2026 for select memorial performances, including festival dates.

name: Lord of the Lost
description: German dark rock/goth-metal band from Hamburg, founded in 2007 as a solo project by singer Chris Harms before growing into a full band. Known for theatrical live shows and a sinister blend of goth metal and industrial rock, they represented Germany at Eurovision 2023.

name: Eluveitie
description: Swiss folk metal band from Winterthur, founded in 2002 by Chrigel Glanzmann. Eluveitie weave hurdy-gurdy, flute and bagpipes into a melodic death metal base, with lyrics partly sung in the extinct Gaulish language, and broke through internationally with 2008's Slania.

name: H-Blockx
description: German crossover pioneers formed in Münster in 1991, mixing metal, alternative rock and rap. Their 1994 debut Time to Move produced several Top 40 hits and an MTV Europe Music Award nomination, and the band remains a fixture of the German rock/metal scene.

name: Swiss + Die Andern
description: Hamburg-based German band led by rapper Swiss, fusing punk, crossover and hip-hop into leftist, socio-political lyrics delivered with nervy energy. Albums like Große Freiheit and the chart-topping Erstmal zu Penny have made them a fixture of the German punk/crossover scene.

name: Clawfinger
description: Swedish rap metal pioneers formed in Stockholm in 1989, breaking through internationally in 1993 with the debut album Deaf Dumb Blind. Regarded as one of the genre's earliest and most influential acts, Clawfinger have sold over 1.5 million records worldwide.

name: Kataklysm
description: Canadian death metal band from Montreal, formed in 1991 and known for a fast, technical style dubbed "Northern Hyperblast." With fifteen studio albums and a Juno Award for Best Heavy Metal Album, Kataklysm are festival regulars famed for their intense live shows.

name: Mono Inc.
description: German dark rock band formed in Hamburg in 2000 by Miky Mono, Carl Fornia and Martin Engler. Known for a danceable mix of catchy hooks and driving rock beats, the band has landed several number-one albums on the German charts.

name: Warkings
description: Austrian/German power metal band formed in 2018 by Serenity vocalist Georg Neuhauser. Members perform masked under warrior pseudonyms across historical eras, and their concept albums like Armageddon (2025) turn European history into bombastic power metal storytelling.

name: Dark Funeral
description: Swedish black metal band from Stockholm, founded in 1993 by guitarists Blackmoon and Lord Ahriman during the genre's second wave. Known for uncompromising Satanic/anti-Christian themes across seven full-length albums, Dark Funeral remain one of the scene's most prominent acts.

name: Finntroll
description: Finnish folk metal band from Helsinki, founded in 1997 and known for fusing black metal with the Finnish dance style humppa. Their lyrics are mostly sung in Swedish, and the band celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2027.

name: Atreyu
description: American metalcore band from Orange County, California, formed in 1998 and named after a character from The Neverending Story. Atreyu helped define mainstream 2000s metalcore with albums like Suicide Notes and Butterfly Kisses and continue touring behind 2023's The Beautiful Dark of Life.

name: Shadow of Intent
