description: American deathcore band founded in 2013 in Hartford, Connecticut, by vocalist Ben Duerr and guitarist Chris Wiseman. Named after a starship from the Halo video game series, the band blends symphonic elements and black metal influences into brutal, technical deathcore.

name: Emil Bulls
description: German rock band formed in Munich in 1995, blending hard rock, alternative metal, nu metal and post-hardcore. Fronted by Christoph von Freydorf, Emil Bulls have built a devoted following through relentless touring across Germany's rock and metal festival circuit.

name: Equilibrium
description: German folk/pagan metal band from Bavaria, formed in 2001, blending Viking metal, symphonic black metal and traditional Germanic melodies, with a more modern metalcore edge on recent releases. Their anthemic sound and mythological lyrical themes have made them a long-running festival favorite.

name: John Bush
description: American vocalist, best known as frontman of Los Angeles heavy metal band Armored Saint and as Anthrax's singer from 1992 to 2005 (and briefly 2009-2010). This show revisits the Anthrax catalogue from his era — Sound of White Noise, Stomp 442, Volume 8: The Threat Is Real and We've Come for You All — with a dedicated backing band.

name: Carnifex
description: American deathcore band formed in 2005 near San Diego, California, regarded as one of the genre's most brutal and influential acts. Across nine studio albums for labels including Nuclear Blast and Sumerian, Carnifex have built a reputation for relentless, punishing live shows.

name: The Browning
description: American electronicore band from Kansas City, Missouri, formed in 2005 by Jonny McBee. The Browning blend deathcore and metalcore riffs with dubstep, hardstyle and trance influences into a self-described "rave metal" sound across six studio albums.

name: Long Distance Calling
description: German instrumental post-rock/post-metal band from Münster, formed in 2006 after an unsuccessful search for a vocalist led them to focus on extended, atmospheric instrumentals. Since their 2007 debut Satellite Bay, they've become one of Germany's flagship acts in the genre.

name: Make Them Suffer
description: Australian metalcore band from Perth, formed in 2008 and propelled to international festival stages by their 2012 debut Neverbloom. Make Them Suffer fuse death metal, metalcore and symphonic elements into dynamic shifts between brutal heaviness and melodic passages.

name: Any Given Day
description: German metalcore band formed in Gelsenkirchen in 2012 by singer Dennis Diehl. Since their 2014 debut album My Longest Way Home, Any Given Day have become known for high-energy live shows and a consistently crowd-pleasing presence on the German metalcore circuit.

name: Gutalax
description: Czech goregrind band from Křemže, formed in 2009 and named after the laxative Guttalax. Gutalax describe their sound as "gore 'n' roll" — a mix of goregrind, groove metal and pornogrind — and are infamous for toilet-themed live shows complete with flying toilet paper and crowd-surfed portable toilets.

name: Blue Medusa
description: Los Angeles-based heavy metal band founded in 2026 by Canadian vocalist Alissa White-Gluz following her departure from Arch Enemy. Blue Medusa deliver dark, technically sophisticated metal built on devastating riffs, blazing guitar solos and crafted melodies.

name: Insomnium
description: Finnish melodic death metal band from Joensuu, formed in 1997. Insomnium's music is defined by dark, sorrowful atmospheres and nature-themed lyrics, incorporating progressive and doom metal elements across a discography that made them one of the genre's most respected acts.

name: Combichrist
description: American industrial/aggrotech project founded in 2003 by Norwegian musician Andy LaPlegua, previously of futurepop band Icon of Coil. Combichrist fuse EBM, metal and industrial into an aggressive yet danceable sound that has made them a staple of the industrial and goth scenes.

name: Anaal Nathrakh
description: British extreme metal duo from Birmingham, formed in 1999 by Mick Kenney and Dave Hunt. Their name comes from the Excalibur incantation "serpent's breath," and their sound fuses black metal, grindcore, industrial and death metal into some of extreme metal's most uncompromising records.

name: Fleshgod Apocalypse
description: Italian symphonic death metal band from Rome, formed in 2007 by Francesco Paoli, formerly of Hour of Penance. Fleshgod Apocalypse are known for bombastic orchestral arrangements layered over technical death metal, with live shows that push the intensity of their recorded material even further.

name: Primal Fear
description: German power/speed metal band founded in 1997 by vocalist Ralf Scheepers and bassist Mat Sinner, after Scheepers narrowly missed out on fronting Judas Priest. Primal Fear celebrate "30 Years of Metal" in 2027, drawing on a discography of hard-hitting, Priest-influenced anthems.

name: Burning Witches
description: Swiss all-female heavy/power metal band formed in Brugg in 2015 by guitarist Romana Kalkuhl. Since their acclaimed 2017 self-titled debut, Burning Witches have become one of the most prominent bands in the Swiss metal scene, blending traditional heavy metal with thrash-edged energy.

name: End of Green
description: German goth/melodic rock band from Stuttgart, formed in 1992 and debuting in 1996 with Infinity on Nuclear Blast. Describing their style as "Depressed Subcore," End of Green have become one of the most frequent performers in Summer Breeze's history.

name: Wolfheart
description: Finnish melodic death metal project from Lahti, launched in 2013 by prolific musician Tuomas Saukkonen after closing his previous bands. Wolfheart grew into a full band the following year and have released seven studio albums of highly melodic, wintry death metal.

name: Legion of the Damned
description: Dutch thrash/death metal band from Limburg, evolving out of black metal act Occult before renaming to Legion of the Damned in 2006. Known for uncompromising, high-speed material and relentless touring alongside acts like Cannibal Corpse and Kataklysm.

name: Angelus Apatrida
description: Spanish thrash metal band from Albacete, formed in 2000 and settling into thrash by 2002 under guitarist Guillermo Izquierdo. Angelus Apatrida broke through with Century Media Records in 2009 and have since topped the Spanish album charts, ahead of acts like Foo Fighters.

name: Abbie Falls
description: Czech metalcore band from Prague, formed in September 2015. Known for heavy riffs and intense breakdowns, Abbie Falls built a growing fanbase through EPs like No One's Above, No One's Below and Hell is Other People.

name: Samurai Pizza Cats
description: German metalcore band from Castrop-Rauxel, formed in 2021 by Electric Callboy's Daniel Haniß together with Sebastian Fischer and Stefan Buchwald (both ex-Fall of Gaia). The band call their trance-infused metalcore sound "Catcore from Castrop."

name: Left to Suffer
description: American deathcore band from Atlanta, Georgia, formed in 2019. Often described as nu-deathcore, Left to Suffer combine the genre's brutality with catchy hooks and atmospheric electronic elements across albums including A Year of Suffering and Leap of Death.

name: Evil Invaders
description: Belgian speed/thrash metal band from Leopoldsburg, formed in 2007 by Johannes "Joe" Van Audenhove and named after a Razor song. Since their 2015 debut Pulses of Pleasure on Napalm Records, Evil Invaders have gained a strong reputation on the European thrash circuit.

name: Lavina
description: Serbian progressive/alternative metal band from Niš, formed in 2020 and known for balancing heaviness with emotional, melodic passages. Lavina were announced as Serbia's entry for the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest, raising their international profile considerably.

name: Accvsed
description: German metalcore band from Wiesbaden, founded in 2021. Accvsed gained rapid traction in the European metalcore scene following their 2023 debut EP House of Doubt and 2024 signing to Arising Empire, releasing their debut album Dealers of Doom in 2025.

name: Spitting Glass
description: British deathcore/metalcore band featuring experienced musicians from established acts, including guitarist David Ball of Sleep Token's live line-up. Spitting Glass made a high-profile early appearance on the 2026 Download Festival bill and deliver a modern take on classic deathcore.

name: Ahab
description: German doom/sludge metal band founded in 2004 by members of Midnattsol and Penetralia, named after Captain Ahab of Moby-Dick. Ahab coined the term "Nautik Funeral Doom" for their crushingly slow, nautically-themed sound, with lyrics that often quote Melville's novel directly.

name: Sunborn
description: French alternative/nu metal band from Montpellier, combining modern metal elements with alternative rock, electronic soundscapes and hooks that border on pop. Summer Breeze 2027 marks the band's debut at the festival.

name: Defiance HC
description: German hardcore punk band from Stuttgart, active since July 2024 and started by friends Robin Khorrami, Sabrina Chaparro and Marlene Feller before drummer Daniel Knöpfler completed the line-up. Defiance HC are known for direct, aggressive messaging and high-energy shows.

name: Regarde Les Hommes Tomber
description: French black metal band from Nantes, formed in 2011 and named after a 1994 Jacques Audiard film. Regarde Les Hommes Tomber emerged with a self-titled 2013 album through Les Acteurs de l'Ombre Productions, blending atmospheric black metal with sludge and death metal into a dark, scripture-inspired universe.

name: Capacopter
description: German stoner rock band from Mannheim/Frankfurt, formed in 2021 and delivering heavy riffs, fuzz and hard-hitting grooves rooted in 1970s rock. Their self-titled debut album reached number two on the Doom Charts after its January 2026 release.

name: HammerFall
description: Swedish power metal band from Gothenburg, formed in 1993 by guitarist Oscar Dronjak. Their 1997 debut Glory to the Brave helped define the modern European power metal sound, and the band still tours the album's material for anniversary shows.

name: Gloryhammer
description: Anglo-Swiss symphonic power metal band founded in 2009 by Alestorm's Christopher Bowes. Gloryhammer's absurdly theatrical fantasy concept, chronicling the battle for the Kingdom of Fife against sorcerer Zargothrax, affectionately exaggerates every trope of the power metal genre.

name: Gaerea
description: Masked Portuguese black metal band from Porto, formed in 2016, whose members perform under concealed, anonymous identities built around a ritualistic sigil. Signed to Season of Mist since 2020's Limbo, Gaerea have become one of extreme metal's most acclaimed acts of the past decade.

name: Peeling Flesh
description: American slam death metal band from Oklahoma, formed in 2021 by former members of deathcore act Strangled. Peeling Flesh call their style "Slamming Gangster Groove," fusing brutal slam death metal with hardcore roots, hip-hop samples and groove-laden rhythms.

name: Nasty
description: Belgian beatdown hardcore band from Kelmis, formed in 2004 by former members of Van Damme. Nasty are known for aggressive, mosh-pit-driving live shows firmly rooted in the modern European beatdown hardcore scene.

name: Kupfergold
description: German folk-rock duo founded by Bonnie Banks and Eric Rhymes, performing together since 2010 and formally established as a band in 2018. Kupfergold mix medieval, maritime and folk-pop sounds into what they call "Asi-Folk," built around party anthems, drinking songs and captivating ballads.

name: Necrotted
description: German death metal/deathcore band from Abtsgmünd, formed in 2008. Necrotted have built a reputation for brutal, high-energy stage shows across European stages alongside consistent studio output, including the album We Are the Gods That Tear Ourselves Apart.

name: Hiraes
description: German melodic death metal band from Osnabrück, formed in 2020 by former members of Dawn of Disease together with vocalist Britta Görtz (ex-Critical Mess). The band's name comes from the Welsh word "hiraeth," meaning longing for a place or time that never was.

name: The Night Eternal
description: German heavy metal band from Essen, formed in 2018 and playing a dark, old-school heavy metal style comparable to acts like Tribulation and In Solitude. Their most recent album, Cold Velvet, continued the band's occult-tinged, atmospheric approach.

name: Halestorm
description: American hard rock band formed near York, Pennsylvania in 1997 by siblings Lzzy and Arejay Hale. Fronted by Lzzy Hale's wide vocal range, the band won a Grammy for Best Hard Rock/Metal Performance in 2013 and has scored multiple platinum albums and top-10 rock hits.

name: Alraunen
description: German ritual folk project founded in 2025, built around handcrafted instruments made entirely from natural materials. Their music draws on nature spirituality, seasonal cycles, and old rites, paired with rich, multi-layered vocals.

name: Avertat
description: German melodic death/doom project launched in 2024 by multi-instrumentalist Sebastian Görlach after his departure from Décembre Noir. Debut album Dead End Life confronts trauma, guilt, and existential despair with weighty, melancholic riffing.

name: Dordeduh
description: Romanian folk/black metal band formed by former Negură Bunget members Hupogrammos and Sol Faur. Their genre-defying, progressive sound - most recently on the album Har - has made them figureheads of Romania's extreme metal scene.

name: Harakiri for the Sky
description: Austrian atmospheric post-black metal duo founded in 2011 by multi-instrumentalist M.S. and vocalist J.J. Their emotionally charged sound fuses extreme metal with post-rock, grunge, and modern hardcore, most recently on 2025's Scorched Earth.

name: Midnight Odyssey
description: Australian one-man atmospheric black metal project from Brisbane, founded in 2007 by multi-instrumentalist Dis Pater. Over 15 releases - including the acclaimed Biolume trilogy - explore themes of death, space, and mythology.

name: Asagraum
description: Dutch satanic black metal band formed in Zaanstad in 2015 by guitarist/vocalist Obscura. Their traditional, psychedelia-tinged sound has carried across three albums, most recently 2023's Veil of Death, Ruptured.

name: Bedrängnis
description: Swiss black metal duo formed in 2020, known for dense, oppressive atmospheres and intense live performances. Two albums and an EP in, most recently Stiller Abschied, they explore inner turmoil and existential weight.

name: Grimner
description: Swedish folk metal band founded in Motala in 2008, fusing Scandinavian folk melodies with Gothenburg-style death metal and classic heavy metal. Singing exclusively in Swedish about Norse gods and folklore, their catalogue includes 2026's Stormvingar.

name: Munarheim
description: German symphonic black/folk metal band from Coburg, founded in 2007. Across four albums they've paired modern black metal intensity with orchestral arrangements, folk accents, and high-pitched screams.
